name: GRAMMER AG Inhaber-Aktien o.N.
summary: GRAMMER AG Inhaber-Aktien o.N. develops and manufactures components and systems for passenger car interiors as well as driver and operator seats for offroad vehicles, trucks, buses, and trains. Their products include headrests, armrests, center consoles, and integrated headrests. GRAMMER AG is headquartered in Amberg, Germany.
